cover.title: Build a small warning library
cover.overview: Hold three reusable notes in one library file and point at each from the right how-to. No unused chunks.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Three notes, three homes
blocks.body:
If you cannot name the how-to that uses a chunk, delete the chunk.

Change the sentence in the library. The how-tos should follow. Do not type into the pulled warning on the how-to. Change the source, or stop reusing it.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Library topic** :  a page that holds reusable chunks. It is not a chapter in the booklet.

blocks.title: Working with DITA Reusable Components View
watchFor: More than one reusable chunk in the view

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: A library note is unused, or a how-to copies the sentence, or a fourth warning exists with no home.

Expected: Three notes, three pointers, three how-tos. No unused chunks. Completeness clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: In warnings.dita, keep pinch-hazard. Add a caution note id="eye-protection" and a warning note id="burst-risk".

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Point eye-protection into bleed-the-valve.dita (create that how-to if needed: three steps). Point burst-risk into a new how-to topics/read-the-gauge.dita (three steps).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: pinch-hazard stays on prime-the-pump (or inflate-the-kite if that is where you put it yesterday).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Every library note is used at least once. Do not add a fourth “just in case”.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Open Text on a how-to: you should see the name pointer, not the sentence.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Completeness clean. Library still not a chapter.

blocks.summary: Three notes, three pointers, three how-tos. No unused chunks. Completeness clean.

blocks.q: Which chunk is a bad first reuse?
options: A whole chapter of the booklet
The product name (that is a key, and you already did it)
blocks.why: A chapter is a booklet problem. A product name is a key. Warnings are the small stable chunk.

blocks.q: A library note is never pointed at. What is it?
options: A spare you should keep forever
A sentence nobody will update, still sitting in the library file
blocks.why: Unused reuse is inventory you will not maintain. Use it or delete it.
